pattern: Composition: a group of toolbar controls (native controls of the AbsoluteUI components), optional WAI-ARIA APG Tabs for pages, and a labelled region of widgets (Dashboard Grid) whose widgets are labelled regions (Dashboard Widget). Editing uses the Dashboard Grid move handles; the builder is an APG modal Dialog (Drawer).

roles.role: tablist / tab / tabpanel (Tabs); the grid is inside the selected tabpanel
region, named by the label option or '{title} widgets'
region named by its title (Dashboard Widget)
status for loading and empty, alert for errors

keyboard.action: Moves through toolbar controls, page tabs, and widgets in reading order (the grid keeps DOM order equal to visual order).
Grab, move, resize, drop, or cancel a widget (Dashboard Grid); moves are announced.

keyboard.context: Edit mode, focus outside text fields
keyboard.action: Undo or redo the last definition change.
Switches between view and edit mode.

focus: Toolbar and widget controls use the components' focus rings. Focus stays on the move handle after a keyboard drop and on the toolbar button after undo and redo. Opening the builder moves focus into the drawer; closing returns it to the opener.
notes: Every drag has a keyboard alternative (WCAG 2.5.7): move handles and Shift+arrow resizing.
Kiosk rotation can be paused with a visible toggle button and holds while keyboard focus is inside the dashboard (WCAG 2.2.2).
Loading and empty states are announced politely; errors use role=alert and offer a retry button when retrying can help.
Threshold tones are a border color; the value and its label carry the meaning (WCAG 1.4.1).
Hiding a widget header keeps the title for assistive technology.
knownCaveats: Manual screen-reader verification (NVDA, JAWS, VoiceOver) is pending.
Many widgets create many region landmarks.
Pointer drops are announced only when they change the layout.
